title: Congress.gov Notifications Congress.gov Enhancements for April of 2026, Part 2
summary:
We are pleased to bring you the second installment of Congress.gov enhancements for April of 2026.

Enhancement – Senate Members – Committee Leadership

  • Leadership titles held by a current Senator are displayed on the Committee Assignments tab of their Member profile page.
  • The Members tab on a Senate committee profile displays leadership titles for committee and subcommittee Members.

Enhancement – Legislation – Deep Linking

  • When you scroll through the USLM text version of a public law, you can click on the icon that appears on the right to copy a link to a specific location within the full text.

Enhancement – Legislation – Statutes at Large

  • Find the Statutes at Large
